story.title: The Western Horse
paragraphs_en: Prakash was a ordinary boy.He had one brother-Praveen,and his Parents-Padmaj Srivastav and Ramini Srivastav. He was underestimated in his family except for his brother. Praveen treated him like a teacher and that made him happy. One day,his parents and Praveen had to go to Delhi for Praveen's college application,so Prakash started living with his best friend-Ravindra. Ravindra was their neighbor and 3 weeks younger than Prakash.

Prakash had tripped over Praveen's favorite child toy-a toy horse. He got a flick of memory near him- They loved horses!!!He was surprised and inarticulated by the memory.The very same night,He dreamt about horses and the next day set out for an adventure-bring home a horse for him and his brother.While packing, Ravindra found him and looked inexplicable. He asked Prakash "What are you doing?"

Prakash didn't want Ravindra to know so he prevaricated "Mum and Dad called me and said they will return early."The next moment,in a jiffy, Ravindra went and catechized his mum"Mum,did Prakash's mum text you that they will come early?" Luckily Prakash was eavesdropping and he had his mum's phone to call his parent she typed that they would be coming early secretly and Ravindra's mom said yes!!!

As he was passing a hay field he saw a stranger on a mat. Prakash looked enervated while the stranger-Raghbir looked vigorous. He noticed Prakash and said"Hi.I am Raghbir. Come and sit,come on." Prakash agreed and interrogated"Why are you alone?""I need my pet" replied Raghbir. My horse ran west. I wanna find him.""I need a horse as my pet too!! Lets team up!" propounded Prakash. They agreed.

Raghbir took of his hood to reveal a hat which divulged his long hair in a ponytail.They high-fived each other and set out for the journey.It had taken them 5 minutes when an aeroplane soared above them. It was the plane taking his brother and parents to Delhi!!! Prakash realized that his parents flight was delayed!!! They had plenty of time. They set of to west to Mumbai. There they rested under the trees shade for the night.

They took out their book about horses and read for 30 minutes. Then they ate the fruits and went to sleep. When they woke up in the morning, they set out to the journey near Mahabaleshwar and Matheran . they found a horse foot print there. They followed it to a stable with horses!!!!!!!!!!!! They had found Raghbirs western horse!!! And Prakash and Raghbir rode their pets and took them home.

Their horses stopped for water and sadly,there they departed. They went in their own ways and went to there own homes. Prakash saw his family aeroplane and came home before them. Praveen saw the surprise and jumped happily.
They then lived happily ever after!!!!!
Hello, I hope you liked the story and please love it and you will keep hearing from me!!!!!
